entities.name: Heo Jun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hŏ Chun was a Korean physician who served as the royal chief physician of the Naeuiwon during the reigns of King Seonjo (1597–1608) and King Gwanghaegun (1608–1623) of the Korea dynasty.
